adds.rationale: Intuitive Machines' Odysseus lander achieved the first US soft landing on the Moon since Apollo 17 and the first-ever commercial lunar landing (Feb 22, 2024), a concrete commercial milestone that puts the company at the center of the profile's named next-wave theme of Moon/asteroid resource exposure, alongside already-held RKLB.

news_evidence.summary: Odysseus lander launches on a Falcon 9, reaches lunar orbit Feb 21 and soft-lands near Malapert A on Feb 22, the first US soft Moon landing since Apollo 17 in 1972 and the first-ever commercial lunar landing
IM-1 mission: Nova-C lander Odysseus carried six NASA-funded payloads plus commercial customer payloads; all instruments remained functional despite an unplanned tip on touchdown

rationale_overall: One thesis-aligned add this quarter: LUNR, on the back of Intuitive Machines' historic lunar landing (Feb 22, 2024), the clearest buildup-phase evidence this quarter for the profile's top-ranked next wave (rockets & spacecraft / Moon resources), complementing existing RKLB. No removes: the defense/geopolitical bucket (ITA, LMT, GD, AVAV) is already at its 4-ticker cap, so continued rearmament news is not actionable via new adds; nuclear SMR and quantum news this quarter wasn't dated cleanly enough to justify additional names. Flagging for visibility: the AI bucket (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, AMD) already sits at 5 tickers, one over the internal 4-bucket diversity guideline; nothing this quarter (Apple's car-project cancellation and China iPhone softness, Microsoft/Nvidia backing Figure AI, Google's Gemini 1.5, Nvidia's blowout Q4 FY24 print) rose to a clean fundamental-breach or peak-enthusiasm bar for removal, so all five are kept pending stronger signal.
